MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Samsung microSD card fits my repeated purchases of removable storage, and its full-size adapter offers flexibility across compatible devices.",
    "The HDMI cable and HD Fire TV Stick offer practical ways to connect or extend my TV setup; HD streaming makes sense for my listed 720p screen."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug introduce voice control and home automation without a clear need in my history of buying device accessories.",
    "The 4K streaming features add little immediate value for my listed TV, and I would pass on the older Fire TV Stick when an HD option is available.",
    "The WiFi extender and Fire TV Ethernet adapter assume connectivity problems I have not indicated; I would choose them only to solve a specific problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although it does not establish that I want Alexa or home automation.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in connected gadgets, while my choices usually serve a concrete device or accessory need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated memory card purchases, along with a card reader and storage cases, make removable storage a stronger recurring interest than smart speakers.",
    "Compatibility matters to me: my history includes specific connectors, mounts and a lens cap, so an accessory feels useful when it fits equipment I actually use.",
    "My listed TV's 720p resolution helps explain why HD streaming appeals to me more than paying attention to 4K features."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my need for storage and TV accessories but stretched that interest into smart-home devices without a clear practical purpose for me."
}
